comments.body: That is one of the feature that will help a lot our current and next users, thanks! Reviewing now.

I've just updated the PR with last changes: 

* never unmount widgets but instead compute a boolean `canRefine` that is provided to widgets. Those widgets will display a new classname if no refinement present. Some, if a panel wrap them, will notify it. 

I removed the display:none from our default style, but still don't really know how to move forward. It still makes sense to hide panel for some widgets (ex: the RefinementList), and for others maybe not: (ex: RangeInput). Maybe we can do nothing about it in our default theme as for now, and discuss about the right implementation with the design team? End users will still be able to do what they want with our widgets in their side. What do you think?

Can we add stories where we have widgets inside panels and canRefine is true (by triggering canRefine with a defaultRefinement maybe?).

So that we can easily work on it.

I think we are good now for this PR. 

As for next iterations we would need:

* Choose and implement the design we think the best when a widgets has no refinement
* Create a `connectPanel` if needed
